notes.title: 7/14/23 Pre-Release Texture Malfunction Patch
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue causing the black background texture frequently used throughout the game to 
   sometimes not show.
- Updated the end credits video

notes.title: Chester: Into The Light Comes To Steam July 21st!
notes.content:
Chester: Into The Light is almost here! The game will be launching on [i]Friday, July 21st[/i]!
Be sure to have the game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2238690/Chester_Into_The_Light/]Wishlisted[/url] and followed so that you don't miss any important updates!

[previewyoutube=BSPHzwOOnZM;full][/previewyoutube]

I want to say thanks to everyone who has supported my development of this game, I'm truly grateful to each and every one of you, and I wouldn't be able to do what I love without you all. 

Sincerely,
- Daniel, Developer of Chester: Into The Light

notes.title: Chester: Into The Light Demo Has Arrived!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Chester: Into The Light just got a demo version!
Play the entire first level right now for free, and start the epic story you've been waiting for!
Make sure to add Chester: Into The Light to your wishlist, and check out my Youtube Channel for updates on the game's development. 
[previewyoutube=BljFdR4SaDg;full][/previewyoutube]
Thank you all, have a great day!
